objective: Allow GA to discover opportunistic trading policies used only while the independent market-state classifier remains DEFENSIVE.
market_state_invariant: GA cannot declare recovery, change DEFENSIVE to NORMAL, or tune the recovery classifier. Recovery state is an external input.
eligible_trade_context: Only sessions in which market state is DEFENSIVE and market has not independently transitioned to NORMAL.
GA_may_search: position sizing and total exposure caps
initial stop type/distance and volatility adaptation
pyramiding or adding while still DEFENSIVE if evidence supports it
transition handling when a live DEFENSIVE-origin position experiences an independent state change to NORMAL

transition_to_NORMAL.principle: A trade opened in DEFENSIVE need not be forcibly closed merely because market state becomes NORMAL.
transition_to_NORMAL.GA_research_permission: Test whether a profitable DEFENSIVE-origin position should be retained, have its risk rules normalized, and/or be added to after the independent NORMAL designation.
transition_to_NORMAL.prohibition: The position's profitability or price action cannot itself cause the market-state designation change unless that same information belongs to the separately frozen recovery classifier.

fitness_design_requirements: Reward net realized return after realistic costs.
Penalize drawdown, adverse excursion, repeated whipsaw losses, excessive turnover, concentration, and tail loss.
Measure opportunity capture from major defensive-market rallies without requiring prediction of rally peaks.
Include the cost of sitting out opportunities and the cost of false participation.
Use walk-forward/episode-heldout evaluation inside consumed development material before any protected-bank access.
Do not use known troughs, peaks, future rally labels, or recovery labels as GA features.
Do not optimize only aggregate wealth; retain per-episode and worst-case behavior so one rally cannot dominate fitness.

initial_research_laboratory.market_episodes: GFC independent false-rally episodes plus other already-consumed destructive/correction regimes as appropriate.
initial_research_laboratory.stock_data: Consumed 67-stock development laboratory only when stock-level trading simulation is required.
initial_research_laboratory.protected: Previously opened 50-stock bank remains untouched; remaining Discovery and Verification A/B remain protected.

not_frozen: number or identity of strategy families retained
scientific_role: This freeze defines what GA may investigate, not what answer it should find.
